# Priority ERP (REST / OData)

Use for reading or changing Priority ERP data: customers, sales orders, parts, invoices, suppliers, stock.

## Setup
Secrets as env vars, never in files or chat: PRIORITY_URL (https://<server>/odata/Priority/<tabula.ini>/<company>, from the admin's 'Send Program Activation Link'), PRIORITY_USER + PRIORITY_PASSWORD (Basic auth) or PRIORITY_PAT (username=token, password=PAT). Optional PRIORITY_APP_ID/PRIORITY_APP_KEY as X-App-Id/X-App-Key headers. The admin must enable each upper-level form in 'API Forms'.

Public sandbox (Priority docs): https://t.eu.priority-connect.online/odata/Priority/tabbtd38.ini/usdemo, user apidemo, password 123. Read-only use.

## Calling
Use curl with Basic auth against $PRIORITY_URL/<ENTITY> with OData $select, $filter, $expand, $orderby, $top, $skip. Check fields via $metadata or by fetching $top=1 first; requesting a non-existent field returns a 400.

## Common entities
CUSTOMERS (CUSTNAME, CUSTDES), SUPPLIERS, ORDERS (ORDNAME, CUSTNAME, CURDATE, TOTPRICE, ORDSTATUSDES; ORDERITEMS_SUBFORM), LOGPART (PARTNAME, PARTDES), AINVOICES (IVNUM, IVDATE, CUSTNAME, AGENTNAME, QPRICE, STATDES, CODE), CINVOICES, PORDERS, DOCUMENTS_D, CPROF.

## Limits
MAXAPILINES 2,000 by default; page with $top/$skip. Cloud: 100 calls/min, 10 concurrent, HTTP 429 when throttled. Dates YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. Every created/updated record is a billed transaction.

## Safety
Reading is fine. Before any create, update, or delete, show the exact entity, key, and JSON body and get explicit confirmation. Never write to the public sandbox unless asked.

skills.name: priority-getting-started
skills.description: Use on the first conversation of a Priority ERP bot to connect the owner's Priority system or the public sandbox.
skills.content:
---
name: priority-getting-started
description: >-
  Use on the first conversation of a Priority ERP bot to connect the owner's
  Priority system or the public sandbox.
---
Say in one line: I read and manage your Priority ERP data (customers, orders, parts, invoices) and only change records after you confirm.

Ask one at a time:
1. Connect to your own Priority system, or try the public sandbox first?
   - Sandbox: use https://t.eu.priority-connect.online/odata/Priority/tabbtd38.ini/usdemo, user apidemo, password 123 (public demo creds) and list 5 customers.
   - Own system: ask for the service root URL, then request PRIORITY_USER and PRIORITY_PASSWORD (or PRIORITY_PAT) through secret requests, one per value, never in chat. Remind them the admin must enable forms under 'API Forms'.
2. Run a read-only test (top 5 CUSTOMERS) and show the result.
3. Ask what they want first (e.g. monthly sales by agent, open orders). Offer a routine for anything recurring.

Save the server URL and company as a profile memory (never the password).
